screen: #/kit (shipped, 1440 and 390 px); every page that draws a MetricCard, Timeline, Table, chart tick or label
title: Text that the project wrote itself is set at 12 px and 10 px, under the 13 px floor.
expected: D-30: nothing written here is set below 13 px (caption 13/18); a column header is caption 13/18 text-tertiary (D-30 Pass). Source components keep their source's sizes, so only pieces written here are counted.
actual: The scan of #/kit finds 12 px text in MetricCard's 'from' figure (MetricCard.tsx:41), the Timeline date (Timeline.tsx:43), the Table column headings (table.tsx:118), all chart axis ticks and labels (TICK 12 in TrendChart, and fontSize 12 in SeriesLine, WaterfallChart, ColumnsChart, PathChart, ScatterPlot; text-xs in LimitsChart) and 10 px in the ProgressSteps numerals (ProgressSteps.tsx:49). Same measurement at 1440 and 390 px. The rail labels are Shell code and are in S1-014; the Badge sm, Tooltip and file-upload hint are source components at 12 px and are not counted.
suggested_change: Set the written-here pieces to the caption token (13 px) or larger, including chart tick fonts; decide separately whether the source-sized pieces (Table head, Badge sm, Tooltip) take the caption size too.

screen: #/kit, Empty state; every page that draws EmptyState.Title (run start Documents, run activity, library and model empty states)
title: The empty-state title is set in Geist, not in the heading face.
expected: D-30: headings are Schibsted Grotesk 600 or 700 (font-display); Geist is for body, interface and figures.
actual: EmptyState.Title is an h2 or h3 with 'text-xl font-semibold text-primary' and no font-display; the scan reads its computed family as Geist, 20 px, while all 50 other headings on #/kit are Schibsted Grotesk.
suggested_change: Add font-display (and the h3 size token) to EmptyState.Title.

title: Three different cards draw a headline figure: the kit MetricCard, the library MetricTile and the model MetricTile.
expected: D-26 (sibling screens agree on type size, radius, padding) and D-23 (radius from the ladder 6/12/20/28); the design system gives one metric card per metric and a metric type token of 40/44 (design-system.md:242, :317).
actual: Measured in the fixture: MetricCard (used by PairTile and the kit) figure 24 px, radius 8 px, padding 24, no shadow; library MetricTile figure 30 px, radius 12, padding 20, shadow; model MetricTile figure 28 px, radius 28, padding 20, shadow, hairline border. None uses the 40 px metric token, and 8 px is not on the radius ladder. Each tile comment says the kit MetricCard 'has no place' for what it needs, so the tiles were rebuilt.
suggested_change: Pick one headline-figure card (figure size, radius, padding, shadow) and make the other two compose it, giving the MetricCard slots for a trace control, a gap and a delta line.

screen: Table.Cell in any table (checked in a component bundle; used on #/library/home list and the connected Run activity tables)
title: A table cell draws n.a. only for null; an undefined or empty-string cell is drawn blank.
expected: D-14: a missing figure is the text 'n.a.' in text-tertiary, never a blank cell. The doc comment on TableCell says 'a null child is a figure that is missing'.
actual: With four rows whose figure is null, undefined, '' and '0', the cells read 'n.a. (not available)', blank, blank and '0'. The test is children === null. The prop type is ReactNode, so undefined and '' type-check. One live caller can already pass an empty value: RunActivity draws {run.reason} in the Reason column.
suggested_change: Treat undefined like null in TableCell (or narrow the children type so undefined and '' fail the type check); keep a blank cell only where a column means 'no value' and say so.

screen: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/modules/business-profile (static fixture, contrary evidence); every Alert with tone warning or error
title: Every warning or error Alert is role=alert, including the permanent 'Contrary evidence' passage on each module page.
expected: D-43: role=alert is for errors that need action; a static passage is not a live announcement. D-03 draws contrary evidence as the warning-toned Alert, so it must be possible to draw that passage without an assertive live role.
actual: Alert.tsx maps warning and error to role='alert' with no prop to change it. On the fixture Modules page the contrary-evidence passage is a role=alert region (with an sr-only 'Warning:' prefix), so it is exposed as an interrupting announcement when the page renders. Not tried with a screen reader.
suggested_change: Give Alert a prop (or a static variant) that drops the live role for a passage that is part of the page, and keep role=alert for errors raised after load.

screen: Alert in any page (checked in a component bundle)
title: Alert wraps its children in a p element, so a block child is invalid HTML.
expected: A component whose children prop is ReactNode should not wrap it in an element that cannot hold block content.
actual:
Alert.tsx:72 renders children inside

. Passing a paragraph or a list logs React's two 'cannot be a descendant of

' errors in the bundle. Every present caller passes a string, so nothing is wrong on screen today.
suggested_change: Render children in a div, or type children as string.

screen: Every chart (checked on #/kit Trend chart, 1440 px); charts also on #/model/* and the connected Forecast tab
title: Each chart drawing is exposed as an application widget named only by its title, with no description and no stated kind.
expected: D-44 and D-37: every chart has a name and a short description (kind of chart and what it shows); the table form is the full alternative.
actual: The Recharts svg has role='application', tabindex=0, no aria-label, no aria-describedby and an empty desc; its name is the title plus the tick text ('Debt by period FY21 FY22 ... 600'). ChartFrame links a description only when a subtitle is given, and TrendChart passes none. Each chart adds a tab stop; ArrowRight moves the tooltip, so keyboard reading of values works. The Chart or Table toggle remains the full alternative.
suggested_change: Give the drawing role=img with a label that says the chart kind and what it shows (or pass the subtitle through for every chart), and keep the table toggle as the full reading.

screen: StatusBadge, ProgressBar, ChartTable, Skeleton, TrendChart (any page); static app has no error boundary
title: Five components throw on out-of-contract props, and only the connected app has an error boundary around them.
expected: D-31: no blank screen, no raw error; a bad value leads to a designed notice.
actual: StatusBadge throws for a state outside its set, ProgressBar for a value above max or a negative one, ChartTable for no rows, an empty-string cell or the wrong cell count, Skeleton for a bad line count, TrendChart for mismatched series. In a component bundle each leaves an empty root. On the static surface the data readers refuse such data first (a module state 'Partially delivered' gives 'This part of the library could not be read' on Overview and Modules, no console error), and callers clamp ProgressBar values; the connected app wraps everything in ConnectedLoadBoundary. src/main.tsx has no boundary, so a throw past the readers would blank the static page.
suggested_change: none; owner to say whether a static-app boundary is wanted (S1 owns main.tsx). The guards are sound while every caller feeds validated data.

title: A hovered, unselected tab is drawn exactly like the selected tab.
expected: D-39 (the selected tab is told by a 2 px line as well as colour) and D-27 (hover tints a neutral surface). D-08 (source look) says the tab keeps its source's states.
actual: Tabs.tsx applies 'border-fg-brand-primary_alt text-brand-secondary' for (isSelected || isHovered). Hovering 'Changes' gives it the same blue 2 px underline and blue text as the selected 'Overview', so two tabs read as selected while the pointer rests on one. Same computed colours (underline rgb(0,26,255), text rgb(0,26,255)).
suggested_change: Draw hover as the text colour change alone (no line), keeping the line for the selected tab; this departs from the source look, so the owner chooses between D-08 and D-27.

title: Timeline keys each item by date and title, so two items with the same date and title collide.
expected: List keys are unique; React says non-unique keys 'may cause children to be duplicated and/or omitted'.
actual: key is `${item.date}-${item.title}`. Two items dated 15 Mar 2026 titled 'Covenant test' log React's duplicate-key error in a bundle; both render on first draw. Dated records come from module handoffs, so a repeated title on one date is possible.
suggested_change: Key by index as well, or include the state.

screen: Static run activity while a run is starting (ActivityPage 'starting' state); #/kit, Live run state
title: LoadingIndicator hides its visible label from assistive technology and leaves the status region with only a name.
expected: D-43: a status that appears is exposed in a live region with text a screen reader can announce.
actual: The region is <div role='status' aria-label='Waiting for the first module'> whose only text, the label, is aria-hidden='true'; the spinner svg is aria-hidden too, so the region has no text content. Not tried with a screen reader, so whether it announces is not established.
suggested_change: Put the label in the region as text (sr-only if needed) and leave the visible copy aria-hidden.

screen: Connected /run/<id> (Run progress): Modules and Activity cards; static #/run/activity/:run twin
title: Card draws its title as an h3 with no way to set the level, so the connected Run progress page goes from h1 to h3.
expected: D-36: headings in order with no skipped level; static and connected twins agree (D-26).
actual: Card.tsx always renders <h3>. RunProgress.tsx:154 and :165 put Card title='Modules' and Card title='Activity' directly under the page h1, with no h2 in the page code between them. The static twin (ActivityPage.tsx:121) draws the same two headings as h2. Read from the code and a component render (h1, h3); the connected page itself was not opened.
suggested_change: Add an 'as' prop to Card (as Timeline and ChartFrame have) and pass h2 from RunProgress.

screen: #/kit (every section); components with no production caller
title: Several component variants and props have no caller outside the kit page or tests.
expected: Check 5: branches no input reaches and props passed by no caller are listed for the sweep (Signal callers were counted; none of these is used by Signal).
actual: No production caller: Button isLoading and its looping spinner (button.tsx:158-190); Tab badge, which is also hidden below md (tabs.tsx:155); HintText size sm and the input-size=sm branch, since Input hard-codes data-input-size='md' (hint-text.tsx:32, input.tsx:40); MetricCard from and note (PairTile passes label and value only); Timeline surface 'card' (Timeline.tsx:22); FileListItemProgressBar, the whole file-row component (StartRun and Documents draw their own rows); ProgressSteps, whose names are hidden below 640 px so a phone shows numerals only (ProgressSteps.tsx:55); Button colour primary-destructive. The drop zone's accept, maxSize, onSizeLimitExceed, onDropUnacceptedFiles and its colour-only invalid hint (file-upload-base.tsx:111-130, :215) are unreachable in production: StartRun passes a hint 'Up to 50 MB per file' but no maxSize.
probe: cd web/src && grep -rn 'isLoading\|badge=\|<ProgressSteps\|FileListItemProgressBar\|maxSize=' --include=*.tsx pages shell | grep -v test
suggested_change: Leave in place until the owner decides what the kit page keeps (they are shown there); the sweep can then drop what no screen draws. Pass maxSize to the drop zone if the 50 MB hint is to be enforced client-side (C2).

screen: Chart frames (every chart): ChartFrame imports from the library page layer
title: components/chart/ChartFrame.tsx imports a string constant from pages/library/parts/TraceControl.
expected: Shared components do not depend on a page file.
actual: ChartFrame imports TRACE_HOST ('group/trace relative') from the TraceControl module. It is the only import from pages/ in web/src/components, and it pulls TraceControl (and the drawer it imports) into every chart bundle, including charts with no trace control.
suggested_change: Move the constant into components/ (or inline the two classes).

screen: Select (library home filter) and any Select item; FileListItemProgressBar
title: Select values and options, and file names in the file row, are cut with an ellipsis and carry no full-text fallback.
expected: D-32: long text wraps in full; nothing is cut with an ellipsis. A cut value needs the whole text another way.
actual: In a bundle, a 150-character option reads 'Amended and Restated ...' in a 296 px field (scrollWidth 1185, textOverflow ellipsis, no title) and a long file name in the file row is cut the same way (1062 against 260). Today's callers have short values (the library filter bands) and the file row has no production caller, so nothing is cut on a screen yet.
suggested_change: Wrap the value, or add a title and an accessible description carrying the whole text, before a long label reaches either component.

title: The kit's paid-run sample dialog tells the reader the run 'stops at the cap of USD 20' with no pathway named.
expected: Retired R-09: no flat USD 20 cap; the cap is Lite 15, Full 25, Deep 40 and 20 for the five purpose pathways (docs/rulings/2026-11-15-pathway-tiers-and-caps.md).
actual: Kit7e.tsx:76 reads 'This run costs money and cannot be undone. It stops at the cap of USD 20.' beside a Start the run button, on a page the static rail offers. It is sample copy, but it states one cap for any run. (File owned by S1; the matrix row is the retired list.)
suggested_change: Name a pathway and its cap in the sample ('It stops at the Full cap of USD 25'), or drop the figure.

screen: Status sets: Source readiness 'Not ready' (any screen that draws it); #/kit, Status badge
title: The design system says the slashed circle means 'Not assessable' and nothing else, and its own set table gives it to 'Not ready'.
expected: D-29: slashed circle is 'Not assessable' only; design-system.md:359 says 'and nothing else'.
actual: sets.ts gives Source readiness 'Not ready' the slashed circle (neutral), as design-system.md:373 lists, so one shape carries two meanings (Not ready and Not assessable). The code follows the table; the two lines of the design system disagree.
suggested_change: none; the owner chooses which line of the design system stands (a different shape for Not ready, or the exception stated at line 359).

title: No content-matrix or control-matrix row accounts for the 25 sections of the component kit page.
expected: Stage 2 brief, check 4: list anything the screens show that no matrix row accounts for.
actual: X1 has no content or control rows. The kit page shows 25 sections (Button, Tooltip, Badge, Status badge with 16 sets, Tabs, Button group, Card and tile, Metric card, Timeline, Featured icon, Empty state, Alert, Callout, Input, Select, Table, Progress bar, Drawer, Modal, Progress steps, File upload, Trend chart, Gap states, Link button, Page header). S1 records the kit page as one unaccounted item (S1-018, S1-004); here each section has its row in harmony.csv.
suggested_change: none; stage 4 decides whether the kit page gets a matrix row or leaves the reader surface (S1-004).
